commits.author: Aditya Parikh
commits.message:
Add gradle build (#213)

* Upgrade to Spring Boot 4.0.1 with Testcontainers 2.0 and modular starters

Migrated all Spring Boot modules from 3.5.5 to 4.0.1 using the
spring-boot-4-migration skill (https://github.com/adityamparikh/spring-boot-4-migration-skill).

Key changes across all Spring Boot modules:
- Spring Boot 3.5.5 → 4.0.1
- spring-boot-starter-web → spring-boot-starter-webmvc
- Added modular test starters (webmvc-test, data-jpa-test, data-couchbase-test)
- Added maven-compiler-plugin annotationProcessorPaths for Lombok
- Testcontainers 2.0: junit-jupiter → testcontainers-junit-jupiter,
  postgresql → testcontainers-postgresql, oracle package relocation
- Package relocations: DataJpaTest, AutoConfigureTestDatabase,
  AutoConfigureMockMvc, DataCouchbaseTest moved to Boot 4 packages
- Jackson 3 compatibility: primitive → wrapper types for nullable JSON fields
- spring-kafka → spring-boot-starter-kafka with spring-boot-jackson2 bridge
- spring-cloud-aws 3.4.0 → 4.0.0-RC1 for Boot 4 compatibility
- spring-boot-starter-flyway added for Flyway auto-configuration

Quarkus and Micronaut fixes (via Junie):
- Upgraded Testcontainers to 2.0.3
- Updated artifact naming for TC 2.0
- Quarkus: disabled Dev Services, re-enabled @QuarkusTestResource
- Micronaut: switched to Testcontainers JDBC driver

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

# Conflicts:
#	tc-docker-compose/pom.xml

* Fix Flyway auto-configuration and test naming for Spring Boot 4

Replace bare flyway-core with spring-boot-starter-flyway in 3 modules
(tc-docker-compose, spring-boot-jpa-demo, spring-boot-kotlin-demo).
In Spring Boot 4, flyway-core alone does not include auto-configuration;
the starter is required for Flyway migrations to run.

Rename ProductControllerIT to ProductControllerTest so Maven surefire
picks it up (surefire default includes do not match the *IT pattern).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Add Gradle build alongside Maven (dual-build overlay)

Add Gradle Kotlin DSL build files with version catalogs for all 18
modules (excluding quarkus-jpa-demo and micronaut-jpa-demo whose
Gradle plugins do not support Gradle 9).

- gradle/libs.versions.toml: centralized version catalog
- settings.gradle.kts: project structure and repository config
- build.gradle.kts: root build with Spotless formatting
- Per-module build.gradle.kts files mirroring Maven dependencies
- Gradle wrapper 9.3.1 (required for Java 25 compatibility)
- gradle.properties: daemon, parallel build, caching settings
- .gitignore: Gradle output directories

Both build systems share the same src/ tree and produce identical
test results. Maven outputs to target/, Gradle to build/.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
